description: This Java source file defines the 'CashierTransaction' entity class used within the Fineract project, representing cashier transaction records with fields such as transaction type, date, amount, note, entity details, and associated cashier. It includes methods for creating an instance from JSON input and updating fields based on JSON commands.

classes.name: CashierTransaction
classes.description: Entity class representing a cashier transaction record, including transaction details, linked to a cashier, with methods for creation and updating via JSON commands.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a CashierTransaction instance from a Cashier object and a JSON command, extracting transaction details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the fields of the CashierTransaction instance based on changes specified in a JSON command, returning a map of changed fields.
